classification.difficultyReason: Identify screen height as the side opposite the viewing angle and interpret centimetre precision in metres.

content.prompt:
The viewing angle to a vertical screen is $18^\circ$ and the distances between the viewing point, $P$, and the top and bottom of the screen are $25\text{ m}$ and $23\text{ m}$, respectively.
Find the height of the screen ($x\text{ m}$), correct to the nearest centimetre.

spec.description: Dark blue sight lines from a black dot P at lower left to both endpoints of a vertical blue screen at right. The lower sight line rises slightly. Black 25 m label above the upper sight line and 23 m below the lower sight line. Black screen text above (x m), to the right of the vertical segment. Interior 18-degree label without an arc. No right-angle mark or endpoint letters on the screen.
spec.mathematics: PT=25 m; PB=23 m; angle BPT=18 degrees; BT vertical and labelled screen (x m). T and B are internal construction names only.
